source.title: HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns

stage: NF stage 10 to 35 exposure; scored at NF stage 45

intervention.description: untreated, uninjected embryos (no nicotine, no mRNA)

readout.method: stage 45 tadpole brain morphology scored by eye in fixed or live tadpoles (major and minor brain morphology categories)

notes: Control ~6% major brain defects (Results, Fig 1d). 'other' = major brain morphology defects in aggregate (missing nostrils, forebrain or midbrain loss, misformed hindbrain), not split by category. exact n not stated; N > 50 embryos per group in each of 3 independent experiments (total not given). Percentages given only (approximate, '~'), converted to percent-as-counts summing to 100, n_total null.

source.title: HCN2 Rescues brain defects by enforcing endogenous voltage pre-patterns

stage: NF stage 10 to 35 exposure; scored at NF stage 45

intervention.target: nicotinic acetylcholine receptors (nAChR); also HCN channels
intervention.description: embryos incubated in nicotine-containing 0.1x MMR from stage 10 to 35

readout.method: stage 45 tadpole brain morphology scored by eye in fixed or live tadpoles (major and minor brain morphology categories)

notes: Nicotine ~55% major brain defects vs ~6% controls (Results, Fig 1d). 'other' = major brain morphology defects in aggregate (missing nostrils, forebrain or midbrain loss, misformed hindbrain or truncated spinal cord, as scored); paper gives one aggregate percentage, no split by category. exact n not stated; N > 50 embryos per group in each of 3 independent experiments (total not given). Percentages given only (approximate, '~'), converted to percent-as-counts summing to 100, n_total null.
